script_text: Something cosmic is about to change everything for Taurus this week as Jupiter shines directly into your 1st House. Monday through Wednesday, Mars in Aries forms a hard square to Saturn in your 8th House of Shared Finances, creating real pressure around money and hidden tensions — this is your most volatile stretch. Mid-week, everything pivots when the Sun enters Libra on Thursday, lighting up your 7th House of Partnership and supercharging your love life almost instantly. Friday and Saturday bloom as Venus, your ruling planet, forms a trine to Neptune in your 10th House, bringing creative inspiration and career recognition your way. Best day: Sunday, because the Sun in Libra sextile Venus uplifts your 7th House with romantic magic. Worst day: Tuesday, when the Mars-Saturn square in your 8th House intensifies financial anxiety. Ground yourself before any major purchase this week. Follow for daily updates.
